author: matthewsS9546FP

title: Super Tour can only recommend
text: I can only recommend the tour, you are quickly to all the beautiful sights especially if you do not have much time in Barcelona to discover everything on foot. Our care Natascha was a very pleasant and friendly person and therefore the tour was even more fun for us. The instruction to Segway was professional so that none of our group had problems. Many thanks again to the team and especially to Natascha for a nice day in Barcelona
author: T3577KWjuliak

title: Segway tour perfection
text: Our guíde was absolutely fantastic. He had a wide knowledge of Barcelonas rich history which even my kids were impressed with. My 83 year old mother was going to skip it but he lead her the entire tour and I was so grateful. We had a blast from the youngest to the eldest in our group. Highly recommend.
author: Patricia_D

title: A Wonderful Ride
text: Wonderful way to introduce ourselves to the city and hit many of the basic must sees at the start of our trip. Our guide Natasha was excellent!
author: sgc107

title: Best Segway tour in Barcelona
text: The tour was very excellent. Our guide was very knowledgeable about the sites and the history of the city. We’ve taken Segway tours in several cities-including New Orleans, Cologne and Bordeaux,among others- and this was by far one of the most enjoyable tours so far. I highly recommend Segwayday - you simply won’t do better.
author: mameyer

title: Awesome Experience
text: Kadir, our tour guide was awesome. I would highly recommend to take a tour with him. He's very knowledgeable and courteous. You won't regret it. Book a tour!!!
author: Roymer_B

title: Such Fun
text: Really fun tour. First time on a Segway and felt very safe and relaxed. Great way to see Barcelona and was real fun. Natasha,  our guide, was amazing and I would definitely recommend it.
